description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing tasks in a non-blocking, progressive manner. It handles processing items in batches with fallbacks for requestIdleCallback, and manages UI state related to progress and cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, with progress callbacks and cancellation support.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) for progressive batch processing.
